label: Shielded — holding the ballroom door
location: The Moonlit Court, the ballroom door
injuries: A torn shoulder from a copied lunge his tutors never drilled

recentEvents.value: The honor guard reforms behind him while the ballroom empties; he is dueling the intruder with the intruder's own kit, copied mid-fight.

unresolvedConflicts.value: Every duel makes him better at the one thing his realm never wanted him to know.

temporaryObjective.value: Hold the door until the moon-gallery is empty.
